items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: We had a little party of Don Miller’s last night... Don says, “Allen, you want to come up and play?”

ctx.x: But there again all the guys, all the musicians, nobody’s out to get everybody. We’re all on everybody’s side. We had a little party of Don Miller’s last night and Dave and Charlie Sepluveda got up and played a real heavy, Latin, modern thing you know, and then Don says, “Allen, you want to come up and play?” And I’m like, “You know guys, I really don’t know any of that stuff, I just know some kind of standard tunes.” And Roland Hanna and Jay Leonhart say, “Allen, play whatever you want.” Bill Watrous, “Whatever…
Did you ever crack into the New York scene at all?
